title: Markov-Chain Text Generator
prompt:
Implement a deterministic bigram text generator.

`build_frequency_map(corpus)` should return a nested dictionary that records how often each normalized word is immediately followed by another word. A final word has no outgoing entry.

`generate_text(transition_map, start_word, steps)` should begin with the normalized start word and generate up to `steps` more words. At each step, choose the most frequent next word; break ties alphabetically. Stop early when the current word has no outgoing transition. Return the generated words as one space-separated string.

Treat words case-insensitively and ignore punctuation when normalizing text.

example.input:
transition_map = build_frequency_map("a c a b")
generate_text(transition_map, "a", 4)
example.reasoning: b and c are tied after a, so b is chosen alphabetically; b has no outgoing transition.
